featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an awesome time at Timezone in Capital Mall, Vasai East. The VR ride was truly out of this world. I chose the Halloween game, and it was so immersive and spooky. I felt like. The VR headset and equipment were super clean and comfortable, and the whole setup was well maintained. Each ride lasted about 10 minutes, which was just the right length for me. At ₹200 per person per ride, it's a bit on the pricier side, but the experience is definitely worth it.

The VR rides were the highlight of our visit, but the arcade games were also fun and engaging. The bowling alley, though small, was still enjoyable, and I had a good time. The only downside was that the place can get quite crowded, especially on weekends, and the AC sometimes struggles to keep up

Despite the occasional crowd and warm temperatures, I had a great time at Timezone Capital Mall
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Ranajit, we’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed the immersive VR experience and had a fun visit! Your feedback about the crowd and temperature is appreciated, as we’re always looking to improve. Thank you for sharing your thoughts, and we hope to see you again soon for more adventures!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Fun Factory in Nalasopara is a brand-new indoor play zone that’s quickly becoming a hit with parents and kids alike!
Pricing:
₹250 for 40 minutes
₹350 for 60 minutes
Monthly passes are also available (ask at the counter for details)

Timings: Open daily from 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM
Last entry allowed: 9:15 PM

Socks are compulsory (₹50 if you don’t carry your own)

Parents are allowed inside for 5 minutes to settle kids

They give a cute free keychain when you leave such a sweet touch!

Gets crowded on weekends, especially because parents are allowed inside (makes it feel congested)

Best to visit on weekdays for a relaxed experience

Though they claim to accommodate up to 50 kids, the space can feel tight with parents around — they should ideally limit entries during peak times.

featured_reviews.name: ayaz ahmed
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this store 2 days ago to purchase 2 PS5 consoles for setting up a small gaming center. Before visiting, I had already called and confirmed the price, which was ₹58,190 for the PS5 Disc version, and everything seemed fine.

However, when I reached the store, the owner informed me that if I purchase 1 PS5, I must also buy accessories worth ₹35,000. For 2 PS5 units, they demanded ₹70,000 worth of accessories. This condition was never mentioned during the phone call or anywhere on their website.

When I questioned this, they said this condition is because an incident happened at their outlet where someone purchased at outlet price and resold it in the black market at a higher price. They also mentioned that even they are forced to buy accessories along with PlayStation from their supplier, which is why they are putting the same condition on customers.

However, we have checked with other stores as well, and nowhere have we found such a condition. This clearly feels like a forced selling tactic and is very disappointing.

If anyone can take action or look into this matter, please do so. I am not a big person who can take action alone, but I hope this review reaches the concerned authorities. If anyone from PlayStation sees this, kindly look into such practices and take necessary action.

Transparency is very important in business, and this kind of experience reduces trust. I would advise others to confirm all conditions in writing before visiting this store.

featured_reviews.name: Lalita
featured_reviews.review_text:
Capital Mall, Vasai was honestly my go-to place for shopping while I was in Vasai, mainly because there aren’t too many other good shopping or hangout options nearby. While it’s definitely smaller compared to many malls in Mumbai/Delhi, it still manages to offer a decent overall experience and is a great addition to the area.

In terms of shopping, there are a few prominent brands available—for example, The Body Shop, which is a nice find here. From the collection and variety point of view, I felt Pantaloons had the best range, especially when it comes to clothing options. Zudio clearly has the highest footfall; the pricing and collection are quite good and enjoyable for casual shopping.

Apart from shopping, there’s also a gaming zone, which adds to the entertainment options. The mall has PVR for movies—it gives the mall a premium touch. I personally never ended up watching a movie here, but it’s definitely a big plus and makes the mall feel more complete.

The food court was the main highlight for me. It genuinely doesn’t disappoint. You have good pizza chains, quick meal options like Box8 (Desi Meals), plus donuts, chai, and a few other snack/dessert/meal varieties. There’s enough choice for everyone, and it’s a great place to relax after shopping.
We celebrated Women’s day and birthdays here.

One downside though—getting autos/cabs in the evening is very difficult; fares are extremely high. It’s better to drive your own vehicle if you’re planning to visit, especially later in the day.

Overall, despite being a smaller mall, Capital Mall is a great addition to Vasai and serves as a solid shopping + food + entertainment destination.

featured_reviews.name: Bhumi Chitroda
featured_reviews.review_text:
Capital Mall Review

Capital Mall is a well-designed and lively shopping destination that offers a complete experience for shopping, food, and entertainment. The mall has a modern layout with spacious corridors, good lighting, and a clean, well-maintained environment, making it comfortable to explore even during peak hours.

It features a good mix of branded stores, local outlets, and daily-use shops, so there’s something for every budget. Fashion, accessories, electronics, and lifestyle stores are neatly organized, making shopping easy and enjoyable. The food court is another highlight, offering a variety of options ranging from fast food to casual dining, perfect for families, friends, and office-goers.

Capital Mall is also a great place for entertainment, with options like a cinema and kids’ play areas, making it suitable for all age groups. Security arrangements are proper, and facilities like parking, elevators, and restrooms are well managed.

Overall, Capital Mall is more than just a shopping place—it’s a complete hangout spot where you can shop, eat, relax, and spend quality time. Whether you’re visiting for a quick purchase or a full day outing, Capital Mall provides a pleasant and convenient experience worth visiting again.
